Messages.Author: Mark Timothy Heath
Messages.Body:
I would like to know what people think should happen in the following
situation:

I was being bleed (by my preditor of course) I Deflected him onto my
prey (with appropriate card), My prey blocked and then as my preditors
strike he played form of the mist... Combat ends, continue action at +1
stealth.

Now My preditor said his action was to bleed me, so therefore he was now
bleeding me at +1 Stealth.

I said that He was bleeding my prey at +1 stealth because that was his
action before entering combat.

What does everyone else think (or official ruling) about this situation?

Sorry if this question has been asked before but I dont get to read this
group often and I couldn't find it in the official.answers or FAQ.

-- mark - s921...@arcadia.cs.rmit.edu.au -

directed at you and you could deflect again.

Messages.Author: James Bowes
Messages.Body:



Let's see if I can say this w/o getting lost.
I think that the action to be stealthed should be the deflected bleed.
Meth A: I bleed you.
Meth B: I use Deflection, to Meth C.

Once the bleed has been Deflected, I think it qualifies as a new action.
Meth C: I will block. (Thanks to _my_ predator!)
-combat ensues-
Meth A: I strike Form of Mist, superior.

The card says to continue as if unblocked, and it was Meth C who was
blocking, not Meth B.

To me, the use of Deflection is not blocking, and changes the action. The
action was "I am bleeding My Prey," but has been changed (thru Delection)
to "I am bleeding My Prey's prey."
Just my thoughts.

Messages.Author: Joseph Cochran
Messages.Body:
In article <3o96ar$8...@aggedor.rmit.EDU.AU>,

Mark Timothy Heath <s921...@minyos.xx.rmit.EDU.AU> wrote:
>I was being bleed (by my preditor of course) I Deflected him onto my
>prey (with appropriate card), My prey blocked and then as my preditors
>strike he played form of the mist... Combat ends, continue action at +1
>stealth.

The action continues as if unblocked, not as if restarted, so
you pick up from the point where the action was blocked. The Deflection
had already moved the bleed, so you're continuing from that point, and
he's bleeding your prey.

I disagree. The original action was to bleed you. This action was
changed when deflection used. The action is now to bleed your prey.
When Form of Mist is played combat ends and the current action is
continued at +1 stealth. Just my interpretation.
